My name is Logan Foster, I am an Echols' Scholar and 3rd-year student of Mathematics at the University of Virginia (UVA). I also study Russian and will soon being doing research with [Dr. Hadi Daneshemand](https://hadidaneshmand.github.io/dhadi.html) into diffusion models and language transformers.

I currently work as a Machine Learning Engineer at [True Path Vision](https://truepathvision.com/), where I build and deploy computer vision models to provide security and management services to hotels. I have built and trained state of the art computer vision models to detect guns and other waepons, and I am currently building methods to automate the generation and collection of additional training data. Among these methods include effecient and distributed web harvesters and automated blender-based 3D object rendering pipelines.

I was one of six students to recieve the [2026 Distinguished Undergraduate Award](https://iwl.virginia.edu/distinguished-undergraduates) from the [Institute of World Languages](https://iwl.virginia.edu/) at UVA for my excelence in learning Russian. I am also an Echols' scholar at UVA, and honor awared to only the top five percent of students in the College of Arts and Sciences. I am also a two-time recipient of the Chick-Fil-A Remarkable Futures Scholarship.

In my free time, I love to serve at my church, travel, hike the Alps, DJ, play nerdy board games, and spend time with friends.
